485:t_1:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「$n taught me that there's truth beyond hope and despair... beyond things that oppose each other.」

485:t_1:4.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Envy, hatred, grief, resentment... They're all human emotions.」

485:t_1:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light and darkness are two sides of the same coin... It takes both together to make a human, doesn't it?」

485:t_1:6.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Yes. And we are the symbols of that.」

485:t_1:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「I can understand what you meant now, Big Bro.」

485:t_1:8.en:
$$マーグ$$
「You and I are twins... We were originally one human being.」

485:t_1:9.en:
$$マーグ$$
「When we were divided into two souls, each of us took on the fate of light and of darkness.」

485:t_1:10.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That must be why $$ズール$$, who lives only in darkness, set his eyes on me.」

485:t_1:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「And $$ズール$$ aimed to have me, who has the factor of light, and you, who has the factor of darkness, destroy each other.」

485:t_1:12.en:
$$マーグ$$
「But now we know each other's fate, and we're about to unite our powers as one.」

485:t_1:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「By my accepting you, Big Bro... accepting the darkness.」

485:t_1:14.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Darkness doesn't mean evil. Being trapped in it alone is what breeds evil.」

485:t_1:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then what does living in light alone mean?」

485:t_1:16.en:
$$マーグ$$
「...Perhaps that doesn't necessarily bring forth justice, either...」

485:t_1:18.en:
$$マーグ$$
「$$マーズ$$... You must find the answer to that yourself, with your own strength.」

485:t_1:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「No, Big Bro. You'll be doing it with me.」

485:t_1:20.en:
$$マーグ$$
「I see. I will live on within you forever.」

485:t_1:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「Big Bro... From now on, we'll always be together...」

486:t_000:1.en:
$$渓$$
「The other dimension where we fought $$ハーデス$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$...!?」

486:t_000:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The underworld... or should I say, the world of the dead.」

486:t_002:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「No sign of $$ゲシュタルト$$...!」

486:t_002:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But he said something that made it sound like the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is here.」

486:t_004:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「It's been a long time, $$マーズ$$. And you Earthlings as well.」

486:t_004:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You just won't quit, you villain! Even though we thrashed you good!」

486:t_004:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「Having obtained the power of darkness, we are eternal beings.」

486:t_004:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you're saying no matter how many times we beat you, you'll just come back again and again!?」

486:t_004:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「That is the proof of one who has obtained the power of a higher-dimensional life form... in other words, a god.」

486:t_004:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we did manage to defeat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ once with $$鉄人$$'s solar power! So if we do it again...」

486:t_005:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ isn't responding to my controls!」

486:t_005:3.en:
$$厚井$$
「That's impossible! The orders the $$Ｖコン$$ sends $$鉄人$$ are Rainbow Wave, which can't be jammed by any interfering signal!」

486:t_005:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「Before the will of darkness, such things are meaningless.」

486:t_006:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Is wresting control away from him all I can manage?」

486:t_006:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「Never mind. With this, one of our obstacles has been neutralized.」

486:t_006:3.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Well, $$正太郎$$!? What's the situation?」

486:t_006:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's no good! It won't accept any of our orders!」

486:t_006:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But it looks like the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ hasn't fully taken control of $$鉄人$$ either!」

486:t_006:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then all that's left is to take it back by force!」

486:t_006:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Do you think you can manage that?」

486:t_006:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「We'll show you we can. Even if this is your home ground.」

486:t_006:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「You don't understand how terrifying this dimension is.」

486:t_006:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This is a world of darkness... The place where the souls of those who have met death gather.」

486:t_006:12.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「And among them are the dead who have strayed from the wheel of reincarnation.」

486:t_006:13.en:
$$ズール$$
「Precisely... Which is why we can do things like this, too.」

486:t_007:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「These ones also failed to vanish completely and ended up lingering in the world of the dead.」

486:t_007:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$. In this world of darkness, you will taste endless suffering.」

486:t_007:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「Envy, resentment, hatred, grief... The negative emotions of humans...」

486:t_007:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Chief among them is the fear of death... That is, the darkness will crush your hearts.」

486:t_007:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「There is no light there.」

486:t_007:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「You will never advance toward the sun's radiance. Here, you will become one with the darkness.」

486:t_008:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「After all that big talk, they just cut and run!」

486:t_008:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「I hate to admit it, but that actually saved us this time...!」

486:t_008:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Regenerated Angels and the army of darkness...」

486:t_008:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Judging by how they talked, there's a chance the enemy isn't limited to just these.」

486:t_008:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「And this place... it's somehow cold and dark... I feel like I can't breathe...」

486:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So this is... the world of darkness...」
